mapper.select: select oi.id as orderItemId, o.order_no, oi.product_id, oi.product_name, oi.image as productImage, oi.sku_specs, o.finish_time from order_item oi left join `order` o on oi.order_id = o.id left join product_review r on r.order_item_id = oi.id where o.user_id = #{userId} and o.status = 3 -- 已完成 and o.deleted = 0 and r.id is null -- 未评价 order by o.finish_time desc
